documents.title: Investment Policy Statement
documents.content: This statement records the agreed investment objectives and constraints for the client's discretionary mandate, to be reviewed annually or on material change of circumstance. Time horizon: long-term, in excess of fifteen years, consistent with retirement planning needs. Capacity for loss: high, given stable employment income and limited reliance on portfolio drawdowns in the near term. Willingness to accept short-term fluctuation in portfolio value in pursuit of higher long-term returns: high, evidenced through the risk questionnaire completed at onboarding, scoring within the upper quartile for growth-oriented investors. Target strategic asset allocation: 80% global equities, 15% fixed income, 5% alternatives, with a permitted deviation band of plus or minus 10% around each target before rebalancing is triggered. Ethical screening: exclude thermal coal and controversial weapons manufacturers. Benchmark: a composite of global equity and bond indices weighted to the target allocation.
